results.name: aksSubnetNetworkSecurityGroup
results.reason: LearnのAPI selectorで現行2026-03-01が最新の公開GA版と確認し、固定REST仕様の2026-03-01 NetworkSecurityGroupモデル・共通定義、および全source_idの属性値/型/enum/requiredを照合した。既存参照ではなく作成宣言で、SecurityRuleのrequired protocol/access/priority/directionは全て指定済み。
results.migration: GA移行不要。現行2026-03-01がLearnに表示された最新GA 2026-03-01と一致し、previewではない。Learn change logは2026-03-01に追加・更新・削除されたpropertyなしと記載。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: Bicep JSON Pointer /name はREST payload /name。式 'nsg-${vnetName}-snet-aks' はstringで、vnetNameはmodule param string。main.bicepのvirtualNetworkName由来のresource nameもstring。NetworkSecurityGroup->Resourceのname:stringに適合。

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /location はREST payload /location。値はparam location string。Resource.location:stringに適合。

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /tags はREST payload /tags。値はparam tags object。Network Resource.tagsはobject additionalProperties:string。呼出元main.bicep:172-174のtag値はenvironment param stringで、module call:200-214がtagsを渡すため値型はstring。

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties はREST payload /properties。NetworkSecurityGroup.propertiesはNetworkSecurityGroupPropertiesFormat objectへの$refであり、作成 payloadのobjectに適合。

usage.label: securityRules
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules はREST payload /properties/securityRules。これはSecurityRule[]で、指定値はarray。

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/name はREST payloadのSecurityRule item name。'Allow-HTTP-HTTPS'はstringでSubResourceModel.name:stringに適合。

usage.label: properties
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties はREST payload SecurityRule.properties。SecurityRulePropertiesFormat objectへの$ref。必須protocol/access/priority/directionを下記で全て指定。

usage.label: priority
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/priority はREST属性priority。1000はintegerで、仕様説明の範囲100..4096内。SecurityRulePropertiesFormatのrequiredに含まれる。

usage.label: direction
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/direction はREST属性direction。'Inbound'はSecurityRuleDirection enum [Inbound, Outbound]に適合しrequired。

usage.label: access
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/access はREST属性access。'Allow'はSecurityRuleAccess enum [Allow, Deny]に適合しrequired。

usage.label: protocol
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/protocol はREST属性protocol。'Tcp'はSecurityRuleProtocol enum [Tcp, Udp, Icmp, Esp, *, Ah]に適合しrequired。

usage.label: sourcePortRange
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/sourcePortRange はREST属性sourcePortRange。'*'はstringで、全portを指定する仕様上許容値。

usage.label: destinationPortRanges
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/destinationPortRanges はREST属性destinationPortRanges、items:stringのarray。各値を個別に照合。

usage.label: sourceAddressPrefix
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/sourceAddressPrefix はREST属性sourceAddressPrefix。'*'はstringで全source IPを指定する許容値。

usage.label: destinationAddressPrefix
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/destinationAddressPrefix はREST属性destinationAddressPrefix。'*'はstringで全destination IPを指定する許容値。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/destinationPortRanges/[]/$expression-line/15 はsource file内のarray element expression。REST属性は /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/destinationPortRanges/[]。literal '80'はstringかつ0..65535内。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/destinationPortRanges/[]/$expression-line/16 はsource file内のarray element expression。REST属性は /properties/securityRules/[]/properties/destinationPortRanges/[]。literal '443'はstringかつ0..65535内。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$expression-line/0 はresource type/versionを宣言するBicep headerでpayload propertyではない。type/versionはMicrosoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups@2026-03-01でLearn/RESTの現行schemaと一致。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/0 はlocation parameterのdescription annotationでpayload propertyではない。関連するREST /location の型確認はparam declarationとbody:47 analysisに記録。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/location/$expression-line/1 はparam location string。REST payload /location:string を満たす変数定義。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/tags/$expression-line/0 はtags parameterのdescription annotationでpayload propertyではない。REST /tags additionalProperties:stringとの照合はparameter/callerを含めbody:64に記録。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/tags/$expression-line/1 はparam tags object。REST payload /tagsはadditionalProperties:stringであり、main.bicep:172-174の実値はenvironment stringからなる。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/vnetName/$expression-line/0 はvnetName parameterのdescription annotationでpayload propertyではない。関連するREST /nameへのstring interpolationはbody:8 analysisに記録。

usage.label: $expression
usage.analysis: JSON Pointer /$symbol/vnetName/$expression-line/1 はparam vnetName string。resource name式内の参照値であり、REST payload /name:stringに適合。

current.analysis: Learn version-specific page documents this exact API version. The pinned REST README identifies package-2026-03-01 and includes virtualNetwork.json/common.json; NetworkSecurityGroup and NetworkSecurityGroupPropertiesFormat are in virtualNetwork.json, with Resource, SubResourceModel and enums referenced from common.json. Schemas.expand/property/literal resolved allOf/$ref and validated actual property types, additionalProperties, required fields and literals.

ga.analysis: The public Learn API selector lists 2026-03-01 as Latest and no later API version; this is the current stable GA schema. The same exact version-specific Learn page and pinned stable REST package schema were used for candidate comparison; current equals candidate, so there is no version delta.

breaking.analysis: The Network Security Groups change-log explicitly says for 2026-03-01: No properties added, updated or removed. Current and latest GA are the same version; no version migration changes apply.
